# `passportsim start`

Create an instance from a firmware and boot it.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Caps group | `core` |
| MCP tool | `passport_start` |
| HTTP route | `POST /v1/instances/{id}/commands/start` |
| Scenario step | none |
| CLI aliases | none |
| Annotations | none |

## Hosts

The matrix below is the full one; this page is byte-identical on every host.

| macOS | Windows | Browser |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes |

## Synopsis

```text
passportsim start [fw] [--allow-tainted] [--boot <BOOT>] [--boot-cache <BOOT_CACHE>] [--boot-timeout <BOOT_TIMEOUT>] [--confirm <CONFIRM>] [--efuse-dump <EFUSE_DUMP>] [--label <LABEL>] [--mode <MODE>] [--power <POWER>] [--profile <PROFILE>] [--seed <SEED>] [--usb <USB>] [--json <@file|->]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Form | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `allow_tainted` | `--allow-tainted` | `boolean` | no | Load `fw` even when its cardid window is not erased or its NVS holds credential keys, which is otherwise refused. Taints the instance: CLI only, with `confirm`. |
| `boot` | `--boot <BOOT>` | `"none"` \| `"until_app_main"` \| `"until_ui_settled"` | no | Boot marker (until_ui_settled). |
| `boot_cache` | `--boot-cache <BOOT_CACHE>` | `"ui-settled"` | no | Restore or fill the boot cache. |
| `boot_timeout` | `--boot-timeout <BOOT_TIMEOUT>` | `union` | no | Boot budget, 10s. |
| `confirm` | `--confirm <CONFIRM>` | `string` | no | Human confirmation code for a tainted load, `efuse_dump` or `allow_tainted`. |
| `efuse_dump` | `--efuse-dump <EFUSE_DUMP>` | `string` | no | Directory of `efuse_blk<N>.bin` files, or one dump file, to import instead of the synthesized eFuse. Taints the instance: CLI only, with `confirm`. |
| `fw` | `<fw>` | `string` | no | Corpus id or path; the bundled demo (`official`) when omitted. |
| `label` | `--label <LABEL>` | `string` | no | Label for `status`. |
| `mode` | `--mode <MODE>` | `"deterministic"` \| `"realtime"` | no | Pacing mode (deterministic). |
| `power` | `--power <POWER>` | `"on"` \| `"off"` | no | Power rail at start (on). |
| `profile` | `--profile <PROFILE>` | `"fast"` \| `"device"` | no | Timing profile (fast). |
| `seed` | `--seed <SEED>` | `integer` | no | RNG seed (1). |
| `usb` | `--usb <USB>` | `"unplugged"` \| `"charger"` \| `"host"` \| `"open"` | no | Initial USB world (board default). |

A nested object or array is passed as one JSON document with `--json @<file>` or `--json -`; it has no flag of its own.

Input schema: [`docs/schema/commands/start.input.json`](../schema/commands/start.input.json).

## Examples

### Start the official demo and wait for the UI

```sh
passportsim start --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "fw": "official"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "fw": "official"
}
'@ | passportsim start --json -
```

### Start powered off, to drive the power button by hand

```sh
passportsim start --json - <<'JSON'
{
  "boot": "none",
  "fw": "official",
  "label": "cold",
  "power": "off"
}
JSON
```

```powershell
@'
{
  "boot": "none",
  "fw": "official",
  "label": "cold",
  "power": "off"
}
'@ | passportsim start --json -
```
